subject.title: Draft: add commands list and inspect inventory

question: Should `openclaw commands` remain a separate public inventory from Gateway `commands.list`, and should `effectProfile`, `commandExposure`, and `hidden` become public plugin CLI descriptor fields?
rationale: The branch explicitly asks for this decision, the linked RFC remains open, and repository policy treats both public CLI additions and plugin API changes as compatibility-sensitive contracts.

options.title: Narrow plugin scope
options.body: Approve a core operator inventory first while deferring plugin metadata and broader convergence until the RFC defines those contracts.

options.title: Approve separate full contract
options.body: Accept separate CLI and Gateway inventories plus the plugin fields after documentation, compatibility coverage, and live evidence are complete.

options.title: Pause for RFC
options.body: Keep the draft open but pause merge work until the RFC resolves inventory ownership and schema convergence.

recommendation.title: Narrow plugin scope
recommendation.body: Approve a core operator inventory first while deferring plugin metadata and broader convergence until the RFC defines those contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The live timeline directly routes the proposal to steipete, and repository history provides the strongest available ownership signal across the affected surfaces.
